market_question: Will Liam Lawson be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?
reasoning: Liam Lawson is not a full-time F1 driver entering 2025 and faces an uphill battle to even secure a permanent seat, let alone contend for a championship. Even if he lands a drive, his team is highly unlikely to be a front-runner in 2026, making a title nearly impossible. The market's 0.3% chance is still vastly overestimating his prospects.
evidence_points: Lawson has only sporadic F1 starts as a reserve driver and no full-time seat confirmed for 2025.
Red Bull/AlphaTauri contract dynamics mean he would need to beat established teammates and top teams in 2026.
Historical data shows that drivers without consistent front-running experience almost never win championships within their first full seasons.
sources_consulted: General F1 knowledge and driver contract status for 2025 season
